text: Mediation and production assistant for the congress Cultura y ciudadanía in dialogue with Mondiacult at the cccb.

Encuentros fuera de carta was a mediation programme within the congress, designed by Jacobo Cayetano García Fouz from Zuloark and Ampparito, proposing a series of activations: from handing out souvenirs and setting up a supply point, to a series of city getaways for the speakers and small happenings that sought to estrange the attendees.

In my case, I took the speakers to the Museum of Illusions and the Jardinet dels gats, handed out CVs left and right (I'm looking for a job) and engraved the cultural rights plan in marble, among other activations.
